# Subway Seat for iTerm2

ANSI colors plus cursor, cursor guide, selection, link, search match, badge and tab color. Tab Color only shows once the profile's Tab Color box is ticked.

[iTerm2](https://iterm2.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/iterm2/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.itermcolors`](Subway%20Seat.itermcolors) | `iTerm2 (open the file to import it as a preset)` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.itermcolors`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.itermcolors) | `iTerm2 (open the file to import it as a preset)` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.itermcolors`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.itermcolors) | `iTerm2 (open the file to import it as a preset)` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```sh
open "Subway Seat.itermcolors"   # imports the preset
# then Color Presets… › Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```sh
open "Subway Seat Tunnel.itermcolors"   # imports the preset
# then Color Presets… › Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in iTerm2 › Settings › Profiles › Colors › Color Presets… › Import…:

```sh
open "Subway Seat Enamel.itermcolors"   # imports the preset
# then Color Presets… › Subway Seat Enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `iTerm2 (open the file to import it as a preset)`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
